component.name: Archive
component.summary: Open, extract and make ZIP and 7z archives

description.p: Archive opens ZIP, 7z, RAR and TAR archives and GZ, XZ and BZ2 files. Browse the folders inside with thumbnails of the pictures, extract everything or just what you pick, and test that every file is intact.
It makes new ZIP and 7z archives too. An archive you open is never changed: adding files makes a new archive. Extracting never writes outside the folder you chose. Nothing is sent anywhere.
